title: Scripture and Discipleship
definition: Scripture and Discipleship means God’s Word teaches believers how to follow Jesus in faith, obedience, growth, and mission.
summary: Scripture and Discipleship means God’s Word teaches believers how to follow Jesus in faith, obedience, growth, and mission.
christFocus: Jesus makes disciples by His Word and Spirit, teaching His people to obey all that He commanded.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Discipleship is not merely learning Christian information. It is learning to follow Jesus. Scripture teaches who Christ is, what He commands, how He saves, and how His people are to live in the power of the Holy Spirit.

God’s Word forms disciples by teaching, correcting, rebuking, training, comforting, and sending. It shapes private life, relationships, church life, suffering, mission, repentance, and worship.

A Scripture-centered disciple does not separate truth from obedience. The Word leads believers to Christ, and Christ calls His people to abide in Him, obey Him, and bear fruit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many believers have been told to grow but have not been shown how. Scripture gives the path of discipleship: hear Christ, trust Christ, obey Christ, and walk by the Spirit in everyday life.

This doctrine keeps ministry from becoming activity without formation. The goal is not simply to attend, serve, or know more, but to become more faithful followers of Jesus.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let Scripture shape the way you follow Christ today. Choose one truth from God’s Word and respond with obedience, prayer, repentance, service, forgiveness, worship, or witness as the Holy Spirit leads.
